resource_requirements: Retain runtime helper CPU/deadline/cancellation, bounded sanitized stderr, 256 MiB non-Darwin address-space limit, file-output limit and no credential environment. No measured RSS claim.
runtime_work: Freeze/import the complete verified chapter chunk inventory and original global evidence; independently bind the whole-bundle verification receipt to those immutable artifacts.

Issue a distinct epoch/unit/revision/recipe-bound helper operation per planned unit; inputs are the exact bounded allowlist. Preserve authorization/late results and charges; no provider dispatch or automatic retries.
Register the two-file recipe separately; existing OfflineAcoustic hardcodes replay_acoustic and must not be silently repointed.
Capture chapter-helper-record.json through verified candidate reads; feed the bounded saved record, unit metadata and original evidence to the existing StageExecutor chapter path.
Fanout/commit/cache/restart/cancellation remains runtime-owned; incomplete dependencies retain NeedsRepair and all adverse findings.
Replay requires saved records/artifacts only, with zero redispatch/journal/accounting/catalog mutation.
